# Prospekt

> Prospekt is an iPhone lens simulator: a live viewfinder that shows what a 14 to 300 mm lens frames on your camera body. 59 bodies built in, custom bodies, 1.4x and 2x extenders. $3.99 once, no subscription, no account, works offline. iPhone only, iOS 17 or later. It shows framing, not depth of field or bokeh. Made by nakolini (Vitalii Kikot and Dmytro Hryb).

## Pages

- [Prospekt for iPhone](https://nakolini.github.io/prospekt-site/): what it does, price, privacy, limits, comparison, FAQ
- [Lens comparison tool](https://nakolini.github.io/prospekt-site/lens-compare/): free web tool, frames of any focal lengths on any body over a photo
- [Cameras](https://nakolini.github.io/prospekt-site/cameras/): focal length, full-frame equivalent and angle of view tables for 59 camera bodies
- [Changelog](https://nakolini.github.io/prospekt-site/changelog/): every release
- [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6760914468)

## Languages

Every page is available in: English (https://nakolini.github.io/prospekt-site/), العربية (https://nakolini.github.io/prospekt-site/ar/), Deutsch (https://nakolini.github.io/prospekt-site/de/), Español (https://nakolini.github.io/prospekt-site/es/), Français (https://nakolini.github.io/prospekt-site/fr/), Italiano (https://nakolini.github.io/prospekt-site/it/), 日本語 (https://nakolini.github.io/prospekt-site/ja/), 한국어 (https://nakolini.github.io/prospekt-site/ko/), Nederlands (https://nakolini.github.io/prospekt-site/nl/), Polski (https://nakolini.github.io/prospekt-site/pl/), Português (Brasil) (https://nakolini.github.io/prospekt-site/pt-br/), Русский (https://nakolini.github.io/prospekt-site/ru/), Türkçe (https://nakolini.github.io/prospekt-site/tr/), Українська (https://nakolini.github.io/prospekt-site/uk/), 简体中文 (https://nakolini.github.io/prospekt-site/zh-hans/), 繁體中文 (https://nakolini.github.io/prospekt-site/zh-hant/).
